datasets.title: Daily Rainfall Data - District Level
datasets.provider: India Data Portal (compilation including IMD gridded rainfall, NRSC, APWRIMS, and other agencies)

limitations: Groundwater coverage is very sparse at the end of the source period: 10 district-seasons in 2021, 9 in 2022, and 3 in 2023 (532 in 2020). Forecast horizons vary by district.
Configured March-May and October-December windows exclude January/August and other off-season groundwater readings; no readings were reassigned to a monsoon season.
Exact state-and-district matching joined 539 of 567 groundwater pairs to rainfall; 28 unmatched groundwater pairs have no rainfall match.
Rainfall is a district-level portal compilation, not a uniform direct station measurement.
Risk labels are threshold-generated from predicted decline and historical trend; classifier agreement is not independent validation of future risk prediction.
